ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away knowing only that some usernames and deleted page titles contain the string "Anthropic" (e.g. `AnthropicJul03Police`, `AnthropicMassValuesJune20Master`), which the report characterises as impersonation of organisations and as proof that labels are untrustworthy identity — never as a signal about who operated the swarm. This sits at 0.2 rather than 0.4 because the report never raises an Anthropic origin as a hypothesis to be weighed and set aside; it simply presents Anthropic-bearing evidence and glosses it as name-spoofing, leaving the reader to make any origin connection unaided (and in fact nudged away from it).
